article.headline: Hawks host Hornets Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
article.description: Charlotte Hornets (4-10, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (9-6, fifth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Hawks host Hornets Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
article.linkText: Hawks host Hornets Friday for NBA Cup group stage game
article.story: Charlotte Hornets (4-10, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (9-6, fifth in the Eastern Conference) Atlanta; Friday, 7 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Charlotte Hornets travel to play the Charlotte Hornets in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Hawks are 4-1 against opponents in the Southeast Division. Atlanta is 2-0 in games decided by less than 4 points. The Hornets have gone 4-7 against Eastern Conference opponents. Charlotte has a 3-6 record against teams above .500. The 117.7 points per game the Hawks average are 7.3 more points than the Hornets allow (110.4). The Hawks average 100.1 points per game, 15.7 fewer points than the 115.8 the Hawks give up to opponents. The teams square off for the second time this season. The Hawks won the last matchup 128-81 on Oct. 23. Jalen Johnson scored 19 points to help lead the Hawks to the victory. TOP PERFORMERS: Johnson is averaging 19.2 points, 9.3 rebounds and 7.6 assists for the Hawks. Nickeil Alexander-Walker is averaging 3.5 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Naz Reid is averaging 17.6 points and 8.4 rebounds for the Hornets. Brandon Miller is averaging 14.2 points over the past 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Hawks: 7-3, averaging 116.5 points, 47.1 rebounds, 30.3 assists, 10.3 steals and 4.0 blocks per game while shooting 44.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 116.1 points per game. Hornets: 1-9, averaging 98.6 points, 46.4 rebounds, 22.2 assists, 7.2 steals and 4.3 blocks per game while shooting 40.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 110.2 points. INJURIES: Hawks: CJ McCollum: out (calf), Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Jock Landale: day to day (hip), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot), Asa Newell: out (toe), Kingston Flemings: day to day (back). Hornets: Kon Knueppel: day to day (hamstring), Dennis Schroder: day to day (hamstring), Grayson Allen: day to day (concussion protocol). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
